data.gender_notes: Anima is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anima is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘anima’ which translates to 'breath' or 'soul'. In Hindu mythology, Anima is a concept that symbolizes the subtle essence or consciousness that pervades all living beings. The name Anima carries the meaning “Breath, Soul” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anima usually hope their child will grow to embody breath, soul and live with faith, good character and purpose.
